title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Somos mais do que um software financeiro.


A Kamino é a plataforma de gestão financeira mais completa para empresas de serviços de médio porte no Brasil . Nosso grande diferencial está em unir um software que automatiza operações financeiras (contas a pagar, contas a receber e conciliação) à integração nativa de contas bancárias e cartão corporativo de crédito, tudo em uma única plataforma. Além disso, conecta-se de forma fluida aos principais bancos e ERPs locais .


O resultado é mais eficiência, controle e visibilidade , gerando economias significativas de tempo e custos para os clientes da Kamino.


Sobre o desafio


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Full Stack Developer para se juntar ao nosso time de tecnologia na Kamino e ajudar a construir as soluções que sustentam o crescimento dos nossos produtos.


Você busca um ambiente no qual fará parte de inovações desde o #Dia1 ?

Quer ter opções de ações e fazer parte de uma startup bem capitalizada que está pronta para acelerar?

Se a resposta for sim , continue acompanhando os requisitos que fazem sentido para essa oportunidade.


️ O que esperamos de você nesta kaminhada:


  • Estamos em busca de uma pessoa desenvolvedora para atuar no nosso time de engenharia, contribuindo com o desenvolvimento de produtos robustos, escaláveis e de alta qualidade. Aqui na Kamino, você terá liberdade e autonomia para propor soluções, colaborar com diferentes áreas e evoluir sua carreira com protagonismo.

title: Technical Lead Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Technical Lead Developer who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

kills: B2B domain expertise, Salesforce, strong communication, process improvement

JD:

  • Act as the primary SPOC , coordinating resources and managing priorities across teams.
  • Drive service reviews, escalate issues, and ensure timely resolution for critical business processes.
  • Suggest and implement process improvements to enhance operational efficiency and governance.
  • Analyze KPIs and reporting metrics to identify trends and recommend corrective actions.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align technology solutions with business objectives and compliance standards.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Expertise in Salesforce Configurations using Workflows, Process builders, Flows, Roles, Enterprise Territory Management, Security Controls, Reports and Dashboards and Sharing rules.
  • Experience in Administration, Configuration, Implementation and experience with Salesforce platform.
  • Experience in Salesforce Customization, Security Access, Workflow Approvals, Data Validation, data utilities.
  • Expertise in SFDC Development using Apex Language, Visual Force pages, Classes, Controllers, Triggers, Indexes, Web Services, Components, Tabs, Apex Web services, Custom Objects, Reports, Analytic Snapshots and Dashboards, Profiles, Creating Roles, Page Layouts, Org - Wide default, Sharing rules, Work Flows
  • Experience in Sales Cloud, Field Service and CPQ, Ant Migration tool, Standard and custom controllers, Data Loader, Force.com, Eclipse IDE Plug-in, VS Code, Work Flow-Approval, Custom objects, Custom tabs, Email service, Html, Web-service (REST and SOAP)
  • Experience in debugging the code for troubleshooting the issues


What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Childcare assistance

Gympass

title: Dotnet Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for .Net developer who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Experienced 5+ years on .Net programing/sustaining

Able to troubleshoot the issues and fix from L2 and L3 support perspective

Able to do changes/enhancements on the application developed in .Net

Capable to create/manage documentation of the application developed in .Net

Strong knowledge with app integration by API or View

Available to be on-call at weekends and night-shift

Knowledge on Tasy application (from Philips ®) will be a differentiating factor


What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Angular Developer- Realocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a multinational French company, in Portugal since 2007. We have offices in Lisbon and Oporto and we are a specialized consultant in Management, Implementation, Development and Maintenance of Information Systems. We have more than 150 active partners and we operate in sectors such as banking, insurance, telecommunications, services, energy and transports.


What are you going to do?

  • Design, develop, and maintain backend applications using Spring Boot and microservices architecture ;
  • Participate in end-to-end implementation projects , from requirements analysis to deployment and support;
  • Ensure code quality, performance, and scalability in cloud-based environments;
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define technical solutions and best practices;
  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines, testing, and monitoring tools;
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and the modernization of the technology stack.


What are we looking for?

  • Strong expertise in Angular (Components, Services, RxJS, Observables, NgRx or equivalent state management tools).
  • Solid knowledge of TypeScript , HTML5 , CSS3/Sass , and responsive design principles.
  • Experience working with RESTful APIs and micro-frontend architectures is a plus.
  • Familiarity with testing frameworks (Jasmine, Karma, Jest, Cypress).
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and modern development workflows (Git, Docker, etc.).
  • Fluent English (mandatory) — both spoken and written;
  • Available and interested in realocation to Portugal.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Health Insurance;
  • Feedback&Coffee – the system that includes Aubay’s Performance Management Cycle, with regular moments of feedback and the Career Progression Model;
  • A Training Academy designed to think of you and your needs. You can count on technical and behavioural training sessions (e-Learning and classroom), Meet&Techs, Webinars and Mentoring;
  • Events and Teambuildings.


What makes us different?

  • Our organizational culture is based on values such as transparency, team spirit, regular feedback and continuous learning;
  • Reference prizes and birthday present;
  • We don’t have a dress code;
  • We know your name and all address each other informally;
  • You will grow in good company. Isn’t this one of the ways in which to develop professionally?


If we got your attention, we now hope to spark your enthusiasm. Ready for the first phase? We are waiting for you!


Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period). The collected data might be transferred or include other processing actitivites, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law. For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority – (please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to o criminal convictions and offences.)

title: Desenvolvedor SAP ABAP Fiori (freestile)
description:
Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) SAP ABAP Pleno ou Senior com forte atuação em Fiori/UI5 e Webdynpro ABAP para desenvolvimento de novas soluções e evolutivos em ambiente SAP ECC e/ou S/4HANA.

A atuação é voltada a projetos de desenvolvimento (novos produtos, novas funcionalidades e melhorias estruturadas), com foco em qualidade de código, performance e boa experiência do usuário.

Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e desenvolver novas aplicações SAP Fiori/UI5 integradas ao backend ABAP, incluindo definição e implementação de serviços OData e CDS Views.
  • Importante dominar FIori (freestile)
  • Implementar programas, APIs e objetos ABAP (BAPIs, BADIs, user-exits/enhancements) necessários para suportar novas soluções Fiori e Webdynpro.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Ensino superior completo em área de TI (Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Software ou correlatas).

title: Linguist
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


About the role:


We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented linguist to support AI training initiatives and linguistic content creation. This role is ideal for someone with a strong academic background in linguistics (syntax, semantics, pragmatics, morphology, phonology, sociolinguistics, etc.) and a passion for language, technology, and clear communication. You will play a crucial role in shaping the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and NLP-based systems through high-quality linguistic data curation, annotation, and evaluation.


Job Title: Linguistics Expert – AI Training & Content Writing (Language: Portuguese, Location: Brazil)

Experience Level: Bachelors or Masters or PhD in Linguistics or a related field.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Create or edit linguistically- rich content including grammar guides, syntactic analyses, usage explanations, or examples for NLP pipelines.
  • Identify and resolve issues related to ambiguity, bias, and grammaticality.
  • Perform quality assurance (QA) on model outputs for fluency, tone, factual accuracy, and language appropriateness.
  • Annotate linguistic datasets with syntactic, semantic, or pragmatic labels.
  • Support internal teams by conducting linguistic research and summarizing findings.
  • Apply linguistic knowledge to evaluate model behavior, error patterns, and generalization issues.


Qualifications:


  • Deep understanding of linguistic theory and language structure.
  • Experience with one or more of the following is a plus: computational linguistics, corpus analysis, language data annotation, LLM training.

Strong writing, editing, and communication skills.


  • Deep understanding of linguistic theory and language structure.
  • Experience with one or more of the following is a plus: computational linguistics, corpus analysis, language data annotation, LLM training.
  • Strong writing, editing, and communication skills.


If Interested, kindly send your resume at:

title: Customer Service Specialist
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?

Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the week!


Job Title: Customer Service Specialist


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $840-$$1,400 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,680-$2,800 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10,5 - $17,5 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.


Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary :


The Customer Service Specialist will be responsible for providing exceptional customer support, resolving inquiries and complaints, managing customer accounts, and ensuring a positive customer experience across all communication channels.


Job Tasks :


  • Customer Support: Respond to customer inquiries via phone, email, chat, and social media in a timely and professional manner.
  • Problem Resolution: Identify customer issues, troubleshoot problems, and provide effective solutions or escalate when necessary.
  • Account Management: Update and maintain accurate customer records and account information in the system.
  • Product Knowledge: Maintain comprehensive knowledge of products and services to provide accurate information and guidance.
  • Communication: Build positive relationships with customers through empathetic and clear communication.
  • Reporting and Feedback: Document customer interactions, track recurring issues, and provide feedback to improve service quality.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory

  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream Job!

The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.

The Customer Service Specialist will be responsible for providing exceptional customer support, resolving inquiries and complaints, managing customer accounts, and ensuring a positive customer experience across all communication channels.


Job Tasks :


  • Customer Support: Respond to customer inquiries via phone, email, chat, and social media in a timely and professional manner.
  • Problem Resolution: Identify customer issues, troubleshoot problems, and provide effective solutions or escalate when necessary.
  • Account Management: Update and maintain accurate customer records and account information in the system.
  • Product Knowledge: Maintain comprehensive knowledge of products and services to provide accurate information and guidance.
  • Communication: Build positive relationships with customers through empathetic and clear communication.
  • Reporting and Feedback: Document customer interactions, track recurring issues, and provide feedback to improve service quality.

title: SAP BTP CAP/RAP
description:
Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) SAP com sólida experiência em extensões na SAP BTP, utilizando CAP e RAP, para atuar no desenho, desenvolvimento e sustentação de soluções cloud nativas integradas a ambientes SAP (ECC/S/4HANA).

Vaga hibrida qualquer cidade.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e desenvolver aplicações e extensões na SAP BTP utilizando CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model) e RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model).
  • Implementar APIs, serviços OData/REST, lógica de negócio e integrações com sistemas SAP on-premise e cloud.
  • Atuar na sustentação e evolução de aplicações existentes, realizando correções, melhorias e otimizações de performance.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Ensino superior completo na área de TI (Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou cursos correlatos).
  • Pelo menos 5 anos de experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento SAP.
  • Experiência sólida com SAP BTP e desenvolvimento utilizando CAP (Node.js/Java) e RAP (ABAP RESTful).
  • Bom domínio de ABAP OO, modelos de dados SAP, CDS Views, OData e conceitos de clean core.
  • Vivência com Git e práticas de desenvolvimento moderno (code review, testes, pipelines básicos).
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma, com boa comunicação em times distribuídos.

title: Data Consultant Brazil
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing

As part of the Data and Consulting team, you will help our clients transform and enhance their strategies through advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and big data, generating valuable insights for the business.

  • Innovate: You will work closely with consultants, scientists, engineers, and data analysts to understand client needs and propose innovative and strategic solutions.
  • Learn and Share: You will belong to a collaborative team where knowledge sharing is essential. You’ll have the opportunity to learn from experts and actively contribute to the team’s evolution.
  • Develop and Present Strategic Recommendations: You will be responsible for transforming data into insights, helping formulate and present recommendations that directly impact clients' business decisions.
  • Act Across the Project Value Chain: From data collection, organization, and analysis to building and implementing data-driven strategic solutions.
  • Participate in Training: You’ll acquire the essential technical knowledge for your role as a consultant and stay updated on the latest technological innovations in the market.
  • Manage Priorities and Contribute to the Team: You will learn how to structure and prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, identify risks, and suggest solutions. Additionally, you will contribute to the creation of strategic content, helping spread knowledge within the team.

What we are looking for

  • Academic Background: In Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, or related areas. More than a specific course, we value intellectual curiosity, autonomy, and dynamism.
  • Interest in Data and Business : Passion for business challenges and using Big Data and Analytics to solve real problems and drive strategic changes.
  • Analytical and Practical Mindset : Ability to understand business challenges and propose data-driven customized solutions.
  • Communication and Collaboration Skills : Ease in working in teams, sharing knowledge, and interacting with different areas and stakeholders.
  • Interest in the Digital and Technological Ecosystem : Curiosity about topics such as agile methodologies, project management, data visualization, data science, and engineering.
  • Proactivity and Entrepreneurial Spirit : You propose new ideas, seek innovations, and are always willing to learn and contribute actively to the team.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Executivo de Vendas Externas - Máquina de cartão - Mercado Pago - MG
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!


Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.

Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.


Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:


  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.


Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:


  • Representar o Mercado Pago em uma Região: percorrer áreas comerciais (loja a loja), identificar oportunidades, entender as necessidades dos lojistas e oferecer soluções personalizadas com os produtos e serviços do Mercado Pago (foco em maquininha de cartão).

title: Consultor (a) Técnico (a) Comercial Modernização II
description:
Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Responsável comercial de seu território, com acompanhamento mais próximo da gestão, tem o objetivo de desenvolver relacionamento com o cliente, mantendo-o em sua carteira, focando em reparos e modernizações menos complexas. O Consultor Técnico Comercial auxilia na solução de eventuais problemas, Captação de Clientes, participação em concorrências de modernização.


Quais os Requisitos?


  • Superior em andamento / concluído (desejável Adm, Mkt ou Engª).
  • Interno: Mínimo de 1 ano como Técnico AA Pleno / Sênior
  • Irá atuar na Barra.


O que você ganha com isso?

  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Previdência Privada e Cooperativa de Crédito;
  • Vale Refeição (com possibilidade de desmembramento parcial para Vale Alimentação) ou Restaurante no local – de acordo com a localidade de atuação;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Plano de saúde, Assistência Odontológica, Assistência Farmácia
  • Seguro de Vida e de Acidentes Pessoais;

  • Cesta de Natal e Brinquedo para filhos de até 11 anos;

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About You

You are a Senior Data Engineer who enjoys building reliable, scalable data platforms and enabling data-driven and AI-powered products. You feel comfortable owning data pipelines end to end, working closely with analytics and AI/Data Science teams, and translating complex data problems into robust technical solutions.

You value clean architecture, performance, and data quality, and you’re curious about AI/ML integrations even if you’re not a model builder. You thrive in collaborative environments and can operate with autonomy while guiding best practices across teams.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field — or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, building and operating production-grade data pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL, including advanced joins, CTEs, window functions, and performance tuning.
  • Experience designing data models and analytical structures (dimensional models, facts, dimensions, SCDs).
  • Hands-on experience building ETL/ELT pipelines using modern orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, DBT, or similar).
  • Proficiency in Python for data processing and pipeline development (PySpark is a strong plus).
  • Solid experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for data storage and processing.
  • Familiarity with data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, PostgreSQL, or similar.
  • Experience using Git and CI/CD practices as part of a modern data engineering workflow.
  • Exposure to supporting AI/Data Science initiatives, such as data enablement for models, embeddings, entity matching, or advanced analytics (nice to have).
  • Familiarity with graph databases, embeddings, or AI integrations from a data engineering perspective (nice to have).
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with analysts, ML engineers, and product teams.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2+), able to work with global stakeholders.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ingestion processes supporting analytics and AI use cases.
  • Implement and optimize ETL/ELT workflows with attention to performance, reliability, and cost.
  • Design and evolve data models and curated layers to support reporting, analytics, and downstream systems.
  • Collaborate with analytics, AI/Data Science, and product teams to understand data requirements and SLAs.
  • Support AI and advanced analytics features by providing clean, well-structured, and reliable datasets.
  • Apply best practices around data quality, validation, monitoring, and observability.
  • Write maintainable, well-documented data code and contribute to shared standards and patterns.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and help improve overall data platform design.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About You

You are a Senior Data Engineer who enjoys building reliable, scalable data platforms and enabling data-driven and AI-powered products. You feel comfortable owning data pipelines end to end, working closely with analytics and AI/Data Science teams, and translating complex data problems into robust technical solutions.

You value clean architecture, performance, and data quality, and you’re curious about AI/ML integrations even if you’re not a model builder. You thrive in collaborative environments and can operate with autonomy while guiding best practices across teams.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field — or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, building and operating production-grade data pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL, including advanced joins, CTEs, window functions, and performance tuning.
  • Experience designing data models and analytical structures (dimensional models, facts, dimensions, SCDs).
  • Hands-on experience building ETL/ELT pipelines using modern orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, DBT, or similar).
  • Proficiency in Python for data processing and pipeline development (PySpark is a strong plus).
  • Solid experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for data storage and processing.
  • Familiarity with data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, PostgreSQL, or similar.
  • Experience using Git and CI/CD practices as part of a modern data engineering workflow.
  • Exposure to supporting AI/Data Science initiatives, such as data enablement for models, embeddings, entity matching, or advanced analytics (nice to have).
  • Familiarity with graph databases, embeddings, or AI integrations from a data engineering perspective (nice to have).
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with analysts, ML engineers, and product teams.

title: Laboratory Specialist (Paid Consultancy Opportunity)
description:
Company - RONIN International is an independent B2B market research company specialising in business, healthcare and tech studies. We are part of the Rippleffect Group (formerly Fat Media Group) and are Company Partners of The Market Research Society (MRS), Corporate Members of ESOMAR, Members of the Insights Association and Council Members of The Interviewer Quality Control Scheme (IQCS).



About - We are recruiting for professionals working with providers of laboratory instruments and diagnostics for a paid consultancy session on an online research study.



Qualifications:

  • Brazil-based
  • Need to have influence for purchases of and/or personally uses Flow Cytometry Instruments, Flow Cytometry Reagents, Microbiology Instruments, and/or Molecular Diagnostics Instruments
  • The purpose of this study is to better understand professionals’ experiences and perceptions of providers of laboratory instruments and diagnostics.
  • The paid consultancy session will be conducted as an online questionnaire, lasting for 20 minutes.


Compensation package - R$ 295 for 20 minutes online

title: Frontend Developer
description:
Ascendion is a full-service digital engineering solutions company. We make and manage software platforms and products that power growth and deliver captivating experiences to consumers and employees. Our engineering, cloud, data, experience design, and talent solution capabilities accelerate transformation and impact for enterprise clients. Headquartered in New Jersey, our workforce of 6,000+ Ascenders delivers solutions from around the globe. Ascendion is built differently to engineer the next.

Ascendion | Engineering to elevate life

We have a culture built on opportunity, inclusion, and a spirit of partnership. Come, change the world with us:

  • Build the coolest tech for world’s leading brands
  • Solve complex problems – and learn new skills
  • Experience the power of transforming digital engineering for Fortune 500 clients
  • Master your craft with leading training programs and hands-on experience

Experience a community of change makers!

Join a culture of high-performing innovators with endless ideas and a passion for tech. Our culture is the fabric of our company, and it is what makes us unique and diverse. The way we share ideas, learning, experiences, successes, and joy allows everyone to be their best at Ascendion.

About the Role:


  • Role: Front End Engineer
  • Location: Remote (Brazil)
  • Employment Type: Contract


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize web interfaces using ReactJS
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality features
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices in UI development
  • Ensure responsive design and seamless performance across devices
  • Troubleshoot and resolve UI issues throughout development lifecycle

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience with ReactJS :
  • Mid-Level: 3–4 years of hands-on ReactJS experience
  • Senior: 5+ years of hands-on ReactJS experience
  • Proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+) , HTML5, CSS3, and related front-end tools
  • Experience with state management (Redux, Context API, etc.)
  • Knowledge of version control (Git) and agile development methodologies
  • Must currently be actively working with ReactJS technologies

title: Assistant Recruiter (Fluent English)
description:
Bilingual Recruiter Assistant (Fluent English – C1) | 100% Remoto

Na Blue Dot BPO, conectamos talentos LATAM a equipes executivas de alta performance em empresas norte-americanas. Estamos em busca de um(a) Recruiter Assistant com excelente comunicação em inglês, organização e proatividade para atuar em operações de recrutamento de alto volume. A posição é totalmente remota, voltada ao mercado dos EUA, com exposição diária a times globais e trilha clara de crescimento para quem deseja construir carreira em recrutamento.


O que oferecemos

  • Remuneração mensal de R$3.500 reais.
  • 100% remoto, atuando diretamente com equipes de recrutamento dos Estados Unidos.
  • Turno de segunda a sexta, das 13h às 22h BRT .
  • Oportunidade de crescimento acelerado (carreira em recrutamento executivo, liderança ou gestão).
  • Networking internacional + ambiente multicultural.
  • Treinamento remunerado e acompanhamento estruturado.


Suas responsabilidades

  • Apoiar o time de recrutamento do cliente (EUA) na busca e pré-qualificação de candidatos.
  • Realizar triagens iniciais via chamadas telefônicas, e-mail e mensagens.
  • Manter bases de dados atualizadas (job boards e ATS).
  • Redigir e atualizar job descriptions e perfis de vaga.
  • Mapear talentos em job boards e bancos de currículos.
  • Gerenciar agendas e apoiar o fluxo de comunicação entre candidatos e recrutadores.
  • Auxiliar em tarefas administrativas relacionadas à operação e organização do time de recrutamento.


O que buscamos

  • Inglês avançado (C1) — comunicação escrita e falada obrigatória.
  • Organização, foco e habilidade para lidar com múltiplas demandas.
  • Perfil detalhista, proativo e orientado a entregas.
  • Adaptabilidade para atuar em um ambiente dinâmico e acelerado.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em recrutamento ou talent acquisition.
  • Familiaridade com LinkedIn Recruiter, Dynamics ou outros ATS.
  • Vivência com operações de alto volume e prazos desafiadores.


Requisitos técnicos

  • Dois monitores | Processador i5/i7 (ou equivalente) | 12GB+ RAM .
  • Internet de alta velocidade.
  • Headset com microfone e ambiente silencioso.


Construa sua carreira em recrutamento!


Se você quer trabalhar diretamente com equipes dos EUA, adquirir experiência relevante e evoluir rapidamente, esta oportunidade é para você. Candidate-se e faça parte da Blue Dot BPO

title: Solution Architect (Modern Work)
description:
We are currently searching for a Portuguese speaking Solution Architect/Developer to work with our biggest customer remotely in Brazil.


In this role you will leverage your technical expertise in Microsoft Teams and Viva to deliver proactive services and workshops to premier enterprise customers in Brazil.


The following proficiencies are required:


  • Fluent/native Portuguese written & oral communication
  • Design and development experience in major Viva components
  • Experience in integrating Viva with relevant technologies
  • Deep knowledge and experience in Teams Telephony and app development
  • Experience in customer and stakeholder management


If you are a seasoned professional, possessing the above proficiencies, please apply!


We look forward to receiving your applications.


Successful candidates will be contacted within 2 weeks of applying

title: Sr. Full Stack Developer (Python, Vue, SQL, MongoDB, AWS)
description:
Sr. Full Stack Developer (Python, Vue, SQL, MongoDB, AWS


We seek an experienced Senior Software Engineer to lead technical initiatives and tackle complex engineering challenges. This role requires expertise in software development, leadership in driving projects, and the ability to design scalable solutions. The ideal candidate will manage the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), contribute to architectural decisions, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive project success.

In This Role You Will:

Collaboration and Execution

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and deliver project requirements

• Ensure engineering best practices are followed throughout development

• Contribute to system architecture and design discussions

Core Competencies for Success:

• Expertise in at least one critical system/service and recognized leadership in that area

• Proven track record of delivering high-quality software solutions

• Ability to estimate project costs and resource needs

• Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking skills

• Effective communication and collaboration skills

• Commitment to continuous learning and innovation

Credentials and Experience:

• Proficiency in backend development using Python, SQL, MongoDB and AWS

• Preference for engineers with full-stack proficiency, particularly in Vue.js

• Extensive experience designing and implementing scalable software solutions

• Strong expertise in software development methodologies and best practices

• Experience leading teams and managing software projects

title: Diretor Escolar
description:
Este cargo estará localizado em uma escola no Brasil; não é remoto.


Com a expansão da International Schools Partnership pel, buscamos Diretores, Vice-diretores e Líderes Seniores com sólida experiência em educação K-12 e histórico comprovado de melhoria escolar. Procuramos líderes apaixonados pela Excelência Acadêmica , com visão operacional e mentalidade comercial para gerir escolas de alto desempenho.

Junte-se a uma rede global dedicada a fortalecer líderes escolares, promover inovação e transformar positivamente comunidades educacionais em toda a região.


Sobre a International Schools Partnership

A International Schools Partnership é um grupo global em crescimento, com 114 escolas internacionais privadas em 25 países, atendendo mais de 92.500 estudantes.

Nossa missão é apoiar nossas escolas para que se tornem a principal escolha em suas comunidades, estabelecendo novos padrões de qualidade, preparando estudantes para o futuro e contribuindo para o desenvolvimento das comunidades onde atuam.


Por que construir sua carreira na International Schools Partnership?

  • Visão Global: Atue em um ambiente que valoriza a perspectiva internacional e a diversidade cultural.
  • Compromisso com a Excelência: Faça parte de um grupo focado em ensino e aprendizagem de alta qualidade.
  • Ambientes Modernos: Trabalhe em instalações inovadoras e bem equipadas.
  • Desenvolvimento em Liderança: Tenha acesso a formação contínua e oportunidades de crescimento global.


Propósito do Cargo

O Diretor lidera com visão e integridade, construindo uma cultura escolar segura, inclusiva e colaborativa onde o aprendizado prospera. Em parceria com sua equipe, famílias e a rede International Schools Partnership, posiciona a escola como uma “Escola de Escolha”, garantindo experiências e resultados acadêmicos excepcionais, impulsionando matrículas e retenção. Suas responsabilidades incluem salvaguarda, melhoria do ensino baseada em evidências, planejamento estratégico, engajamento da comunidade e desempenho comercial.

O Diretor se reporta ao Diretor Regional (RMD).


Responsabilidades-Chave

(Com peso igual de 25% cada)

  • Desenvolvimento e bem-estar da equipe
  • Resultados de aprendizado dos estudantes
  • Engajamento comunitário e experiência das famílias
  • Desempenho comercial


Competências-Chave

Planejamento estratégico, liderança educacional, gestão de proteção infantil, liderança inclusiva, inteligência emocional, construção de comunidade, engajamento de stakeholders, desenvolvimento de equipes, gestão de desempenho, comunicação eficaz, tomada de decisão baseada em dados, marketing educacional, finanças, gestão de mudança e colaboração.


Compromisso com a Proteção Infantil

A International Schools Partnership está comprometida com a segurança e o bem-estar de crianças e jovens. Todos os profissionais devem cumprir processos rigorosos de verificação de antecedentes referentes aos últimos 10 anos de experiência.


Compromisso com Diversidade, Inclusão e Pertencimento

A International Schools Partnership promove uma cultura inclusiva e acolhedora, contratando e desenvolvendo talentos independentemente de gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, idade, deficiência, neurodivergência ou origem socioeconômica. Encorajamos candidaturas de profissionais que compartilham nossos valores e desejam contribuir para o sucesso da organização.

title: Técnico de Enfermagem do Trabalho
description:
Tarefas.

  • Realizar atendimentos ambulatoriais (curativos, aferições, administração de medicamentos) e apoiar o Médico do Trabalho nas rotinas do ambulatório;
  • Controlar diariamente medicamentos, materiais e equipamentos médico-hospitalares, incluindo verificação das bolsas de primeiros socorros;
  • Agendar e acompanhar exames ocupacionais (admissionais, periódicos, demissionais, retorno ao trabalho e mudança de função);
  • Registrar e controlar atestados, afastamentos e situações de saúde dos colaboradores;
  • Auxiliar na investigação de acidentes, abertura de CAT e acompanhamento dos casos;
  • Participar da integração de novos colaboradores e apoiar campanhas de saúde, SIPAT e demais ações preventivas;
  • Apoiar o cumprimento das Normas Regulamentadoras (NR-7, NR-32, NR-1), realizar visitas domiciliares ou hospitalares quando necessário, e executar demais atividades inerentes à função atendendo aos padrões de qualidade, saúde, segurança, meio ambiente e eficiência energética estabelecidos pela companhia.


Perfil.

  • Curso completo em Técnico de Enfermagem do Trabalho;
  • Registro no Órgão Profissional (COREN);
  • Pacote Office básico;
  • Conhecimento no sistema Sênior será um diferencial;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no 2º turno


Benefícios.

  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Prêmio Assiduidade - Vale-alimentação Sodexo;
  • PPR;
  • Convênio com farmácia;
  • Transporte;
  • Alimentação na empresa subsidiada com refeitório próprio.

title: Technical Program Manager
description:
Job Title: Technical Program Manager/Delivery Manager

Duration: Fulltime with CriticalRiver

Location: Brazil/Costa Rica

Need to support PST timings

Job Profile:

  • Manage delivery for our key customers across all the technological tracks
  • Manage and lead teams across technologies, fostering a collaborative and productive work environment.
  • Ensure regular updates to customer stake holders sent through WSRs
  • Conduct MBRs and QBRs
  • Achieve high customer delight


Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and budget by working with technology teams.
  • Work closely with customer stake holders and ensure the project scope is well understood and documented as per the defined standards
  • Manage and lead teams across technologies, fostering a collaborative and productive work environment.
  • Work with PMO and ensure quality control procedures to ensure high standards in the delivery.
  • Act as a delivery point of contact for Customer, Understanding the Customer, managing expectations and ensuring highest customer satisfaction.
  • Service/Project Review meetings with Customer and Management
  • Adopt customer specific processes and methodologies.
  • Proactively Identify, evaluate, and mitigate project risks effectively.
  • Ensure that the project teams meet SLAs and avoid service credits / penalties.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance project delivery processes, methodologies, and best practices.
  • Utilize effective conflict resolution and negotiation tactics to maintain high-level performance within service teams.
  • Establish and monitor KRAs and KPIs as performance metrics for team members.
  • Support hiring the right resources for various tracks as the roles get identified by working with the TAG teams
  • Ensure SOWs are signed and Invoices cleared on-time by working with finance teams and the customer stakeholders
  • Continuously work with individual members in the project teams and ensure their contributions are made visible to customer in terms of activities/stories/Jira Tickets as applicable on a weekly basis and obtain continuous feedback on the performance of the teams and course correct as needed appropriately.
  • Work with customer stake holders, identify the opportunities, proactively create proposals with efforts, solutioning and financials


Skills:

  • Bachelor s or Master s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • Proven experience in software development project management, must have worked with onshore/Nearshore/offshore model. Open to be flexible to be able to speak to teams in different time zones.
  • Exceptional communication, interpersonal, thought leadership skills with the ability to effectively engage with customers, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong leadership and team management skills.
  • Familiarity with various project management tools and methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum, ITIL).
  • Problem-solving mindset and ability to manage complex project challenges

title: Appointment Setter
description:
Appointment Setter - Fully Remote

About the Job:

We are looking for someone who will be setting appointments with leads, has great written and spoken English skills, has attention to detail and organizational skills.

You will be given various tasks to perform, but your major role is to help us set appointments for our clients' leads. You will be responsible for replying via the text message system with our warm leads on time, booking them into appointments, making phone calls, and asking a few qualifying questions. Full training is provided.

This is a full-time role Mon-Fri for 40 hours per week with occasional overtime. Work time from 8:30am – 5.00pm New York Time (with a 30-minute break). You will be working with US clients, but you can live outside of the US; therefore, we would like to have someone in our team who knows American Culture and speaks decent English. Experience with appointment setting, understanding a fitness niche and/or having a sales/ business/ marketing background is an advantage. The company may offer growth opportunities depending on performance.

Requirements:

  • Strong English skills, a neutral accent, and familiarity with American culture.
  • Commitment to working 8:30am – 5.00pm New York Time.
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills.
  • Passion for digital marketing and a hunger to learn.
  • Experience in marketing or fitness is a bonus, but not required.
  • Attention to detail is a must ( !!!>> When filling out the form, put your postcode as G9999, DO NOT put your real postcode <
  • Comfortable working in a small team and picking up other jobs as required

What We Offer:

  • Enjoy long-term stability and 100% remote.
  • Join a supportive team.
  • Get top-notch training in marketing and beyond.
  • Starting at $600/month with performance bonuses as you grow.
  • Enjoy weekly payments for financial peace of mind.
  • Receive a 13th salary as a bonus.
  • Growth Opportunities and Full Training

We are looking for someone who will be setting appointments with leads, has great written and spoken English skills, has attention to detail and organizational skills.

You will be given various tasks to perform, but your major role is to help us set appointments for our clients' leads. You will be responsible for replying via the text message system with our warm leads on time, booking them into appointments, making phone calls, and asking a few qualifying questions. Full training is provided.

This is a full-time role Mon-Fri for 40 hours per week with occasional overtime. Work time from 8:30am – 5.00pm New York Time (with a 30-minute break). You will be working with US clients, but you can live outside of the US; therefore, we would like to have someone in our team who knows American Culture and speaks decent English. Experience with appointment setting, understanding a fitness niche and/or having a sales/ business/ marketing background is an advantage. The company may offer growth opportunities depending on performance.

Requirements:

  • Strong English skills, a neutral accent, and familiarity with American culture.
  • Commitment to working 8:30am – 5.00pm New York Time.
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills.
  • Passion for digital marketing and a hunger to learn.
  • Experience in marketing or fitness is a bonus, but not required.
  • Attention to detail is a must ( !!!>> When filling out the form, put your postcode as G9999, DO NOT put your real postcode <
  • Comfortable working in a small team and picking up other jobs as required

What We Offer:

  • Enjoy long-term stability and 100% remote.
  • Join a supportive team.
  • Get top-notch training in marketing and beyond.
  • Starting at $600/month with performance bonuses as you grow.
  • Enjoy weekly payments for financial peace of mind.
  • Receive a 13th salary as a bonus.
  • Growth Opportunities and Full Training

title: Senior Growth Manager
description:
About us


We are a leading global player in the digital assets industry, operating one of the most advanced and trusted ecosystems in the blockchain space. With a user base exceeding 120 million worldwide, our platform offers a comprehensive suite of digital asset products and services designed to meet the needs of both retail and institutional clients.


Our mission is to accelerate the evolution of the digital economy by enabling secure, intelligent, and efficient transactions. We believe digital assets are redefining the foundations of global finance — and we are committed to empowering that transformation responsibly.


As one of the fastest-growing organizations in the sector, we foster a culture of innovation, integrity, and excellence. For professionals seeking meaningful challenges, cutting-edge projects, and the opportunity to shape the future of finance, we provide an environment that values both expertise and vision.


What you'll do


  • Drive overall business expansion across the Brazil region, setting strategies and delivering measurable growth.
  • Oversee business development, marketing, and operations with a deep understanding of growth levers to boost user acquisition and trading activity.
  • Operate as a true business owner—design new initiatives to elevate operational excellence, refine the local business model, and execute plans end-to-end.
  • Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing local team, determining hiring needs and shaping the long-term market strategy.
  • Manage budgeting, P&L performance, and financial goals to meet user and trading volume targets.
  • Lead major local marketing efforts, including partnership development and the execution of key events.
  • Serve as the company’s representative at local events, in media engagements, and in communications with external stakeholders.


What You’ll Need

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience with demonstrated success in a comparable leadership role.
  • Exceptional interpersonal abilities and proven leadership skills with an entrepreneurial mindset.
  • A strong passion for the cryptocurrency space.
  • Native-level proficiency in Spanish and English.

title: 销售经理
description:
Professional competence (Job related) 专业能力 （与工作相关）:

  • 3年及以上食品配料或添加剂行业销售经验，有亲水胶体相关从业经验者优先；
  • 熟悉亲水胶体（卡拉胶、琼脂、复配食品添加剂等）产品应用技术，具备与客户针对亲水胶体应用技术方面进行沟通交流；
  • 语言：除本国母语外，要求英语流利，中文沟通者更佳；
  • 良好的书面及口头表达能力，熟练使用常用办公软件。
  • 有较强的商务谈判能力


  • At least 3 years and above sales experiences in food ingredients or food additives industry,working experience in hydrocolloid industry is preferred.
  • Be familiar with the application technology of hydrocolloid, and have the ability to develop project with customer by using carrageenan, agar, konjac gum and blended solutions.

（3）Language: In addition to native language, English fluency is required, Chinese communicator is preferred

（4）Good written and oral communication ability, proficiency with office software.

（5）Good commercial negotiation ability


主要职责：

  • 负责市场开发、客户开发和维护和销售管理等工作。
  • 负责所属区域的产品宣传、推广和销售,完成销售的任务指标。
  • 制定自己的销售计划，并按计划拜访客户和开发新客户。
  • 搜集与寻找客户资料，建立客户档案。
  • 做好销售合同的签订、履行与管理等相关工作，以及协调处理各类市场问题。
  • 具有团队协作精神，有效利用内部、外部资源完成销售目标。


Key Accountabilities

(1) Responsible for market development, customer development maintenance and sales management.

(2) Responsible for product publicity, promotion and sales in the region, and complete the sales target.

(3) Make your own sales plan, visit customers and develop new customers as planned.

(4) Collect and find customer information, and establish customer files.

(5) Well management of sales contract signing, implementation, and with good coordination and deal with various market issues.

(6) Have good teamwork spirit, and effectively use internal and external resources to achieve sales targets.

title: Assistente de contratos
description:
Junte-se a Forvis Mazars


Se você quer uma carreira repleta de oportunidades, desafios, crescimento contínuo e um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e inovador, venha para a Forvis Mazars.


Sobre Nós


Somos uma das 10 maiores empresas em prestação de serviços, reconhecidos pela nossa excelência e capacidade de fornecer uma experiência única aos nossos clientes e equipes. Acreditamos que o crescimento sustentável é alcançado através do investimento no desenvolvimento de nossos colaboradores e novas tecnologias.

Como uma empresa global mantemos alto nível de excelência garantindo uma experiência única através de qualificação, trabalho integrado, tecnologia e desenvolvimento contínuo de nosso time.


Sua Jornada Conosco


Aqui, você terá a chance de trabalhar com um time de alto nível atendendo clientes globais, construindo conexões valiosas e evoluindo suas habilidades e competências. Oferecemos programas de treinamento focados no seu crescimento e qualificação, programas de desenvolvimento & performance e um ambiente que promove a excelência e aprendizado. Além do trabalho, cuidamos do seu bem-estar, garantindo um ambiente acolhedor, cultivando a riqueza das relações interpessoais.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:


  • Realizar a conferência e validação de documentos contratuais (FCU, RFI e Contratos de Solo), verificando se os dados extraídos pelo sistema estão corretos em relação aos documentos originais.
  • Conferir dados extraídos automaticamente comparando com documentos PDF originais
  • Identificar e reportar inconsistências ou erros de extração
  • Classificar documentos conforme critérios estabelecidos
  • Preencher checklists de validação no sistema
  • Apoiar na organização e controle do fluxo de documentos


Requisitos / Qualificações:


  • Ensino superior cursando ou completo em Administração, Direito, Gestão ou áreas correlatas
  • Atenção a detalhes e capacidade de trabalho metódico
  • Excel nível intermediário (filtros, organização de dados)
  • Boa capacidade de leitura e interpretação de documentos
  • Vivência com conferência ou validação documental
  • Conhecimento básico de contratos


Benefícios


  • Serviço de telemedicina;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Canal de apoio psicológico;
  • Convênio com o SESC;
  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação (Cartão Flash) – flexibilidade para o seu dia a dia;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Assistência Médica (Amil);
  • Assistência Odontológica (Amil);
  • Seguro de vida (SulAmérica)
  • Descontos e, incentivos educacionais em diversas instituições.


Se você se identificou com o nosso jeito de ser, venha fazer parte do nosso time! Aqui teremos diversas oportunidades e desafios para que você possa contribuir e se desenvolver em conjunto conosco.

title: Gerente de projetos sênior
description:
Sobre a oportunidade

Buscamos um Project Manager com forte atuação em projetos de tecnologia para liderar um discovery tecnológico envolvendo modernização arquitetural e implantação prática de DevSecOps. O profissional será responsável por conduzir o ciclo completo do discovery, garantindo alinhamento entre equipes técnicas, gestão executiva e stakeholders de negócio.


Responsabilidades

Liderar a execução do discovery tecnológico, assegurando ritmo, qualidade e aderência ao escopo.

Conduzir entrevistas, workshops e reuniões com áreas técnicas e de negócio.

Apoiar o mapeamento de competências, processos e práticas organizacionais.

Acompanhar riscos, dependências e promover ações corretivas.

Preparar e apresentar entregáveis executivos, incluindo diagnóstico, recomendações e roadmap.


Requisitos

Experiência como PM em iniciativas de arquitetura, modernização ou DevOps.

Comunicação executiva excelente.

Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis e gestão orientada a valor.


Temporário 3 meses. podendo permanacer.

100% remoto

title: PESSOA DESENVOLVEDORA .NET PL
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições

- Desenvolver e manter aplicações em .NET utilizando C#.

- Desenvolver e manter interfaces web utilizando JavaScript, Angular, React, HTML/CSS.

- Desenvolver e manter queries SQL para manipulação de dados em bancos de dados relacionais

- Realizar testes unitários e integração contínua

- Trabalhar em equipe em um ambiente ágil utilizando Git e JIRA

- Demonstrar proatividade, resiliência e adaptabilidade no ambiente de trabalho


Requisitos e qualificações

- Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas relacionadas

- Certificações em Tecnologias Relevantes (ex: AZ-900...)

- Pós-graduação em Desenvolvimento de Software ou áreas relacionadas

- Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento com a linguagem C# .

- Sólido conhecimento em .NET Core/5/6+ e/ou .NET Framework .

- Proficiência em desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful (Web API).

- Experiência com Git ou outros sistemas de controle de versão.

- Conhecimento em Orientação a Objetos (POO) , padrões de projeto (como MVC , MVVM ) e princípios SOLID .

- Experiência com banco de dados relacionais como SQL Server, conhecimento em banco de dados não relacionais como MongoDB e ElasticSearch

- Conhecimento em DevOps, CI/CD, conteinerização.

- Diferencial: Conhecimento em IA, LLMs, Machine Learning.

- Habilidade de comunicação e trabalho em equipe


Informações adicionais

O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.
  • Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.


Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
  • Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.
  • Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.
  • Conexa: Atendimento psicológico gratuito para cuidar da sua saúde mental.
  • Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.
  • Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.


Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

title: Tech Lead React
description:
Tech Lead | React Web

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.



Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?



Qual será o seu papel?

Você atuará como Tech Lead React Web, sendo a referência técnica do time e também alguém que trabalha de forma ativa no desenvolvimento. Seu papel envolve orientar a equipe, garantir a qualidade das entregas, apoiar decisões técnicas, participar de entrevistas, promover as melhores práticas de frontend e assegurar que processos, documentação e ritmo de evolução do time estejam sempre alinhados. Além de liderar, você colocará a mão na massa na construção de interfaces, criação de componentes escaláveis e manutenção de uma base sólida de frontend, contribuindo diretamente para a experiência do usuário e para a evolução contínua do projeto.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Alinhar e acompanhar objetivos do time, garantindo que os processos da Rethink sejam seguidos;
  • Acompanhar a evolução das tarefas ao longo do ciclo de desenvolvimento, identificando riscos para a entrega e atuando para mitigá-los;
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento web, criando componentes reutilizáveis e escaláveis com React, desenvolvendo interfaces responsivas e acessíveis, e colaborando com design e backend;
  • Identificar e resolver problemas de desempenho para manter interfaces rápidas e confiáveis;
  • Realizar revisões de código, orientar padrões e propor melhorias contínuas;
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) em tecnologias e boas práticas de frontend;
  • Atuar como a principal referência técnica para o time e para o cliente, apoiando decisões, direcionando soluções e garantindo alinhamento entre necessidades do projeto e capacidades da equipe;
  • Conduzir entrevistas e avaliar candidatos para compor o time de TI sob sua responsabilidade, assegurando que o perfil técnico e comportamental esteja aderente às necessidades do projeto;
  • Garantir que o time mantenha atualizadas as ferramentas e artefatos essenciais ao fluxo de trabalho, como Jira, documentações e registros de processo, preservando organização, histórico e visibilidade;
  • Identificar oportunidades de capacitação e necessidades de desenvolvimento do time, promovendo nivelamento técnico e incentivando uma evolução contínua e estruturada da equipe;
  • Apoiar o time de projetos na elaboração de cronogramas e estimativas, trazendo visão técnica para planejar entregas, dimensionar esforço e antecipar riscos;
  • Desenvolver, implementar e otimizar interfaces responsivas e acessíveis, aplicando boas práticas de UX/UI e garantindo uma experiência fluida, inclusiva e eficiente para o usuário;
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento web, guiando decisões técnicas, garantindo a adoção de boas práticas e assegurando que o produto avance com qualidade, consistência e escalabilidade.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Domínio no desenvolvimento frontend utilizando React e seu ecossistema (Redux, React Router, Context API etc.);
  • Experiência com HTML5, CSS3 e pré-processadores de CSS (ex: SASS, LESS);
  • Familiaridade com testes de frontend (ex: Jest, React Testing Library).
  • Familiaridade com conceitos de User Experience (UX) e User Interface (UI);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de versionamento de código, preferencialmente Git;
  • Conhecimento em prototipagem de interfaces utilizando Figma ou outras ferramentas de design;
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);
  • Experiência com integração de APIs RESTful, com práticas de DevOps e pipelines de CI/CD aplicadas ao frontend;
  • Proatividade, perfil comunicativo, resolução de problemas complexos e busca por melhoria contínua.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Tiver experiência com TypeScript;
  • Tiver experiência com gerenciamento de dependências usando NPM e/ou YARN;
  • Conhecer bibliotecas de UI como Material UI, Ant Design ou similares;
  • Aplicar práticas de acessibilidade seguindo diretrizes como WCAG;
  • Tiver vivência com integrações em nuvem (AWS ou outras plataformas);
  • Conhecer princípios de SEO aplicados a aplicações web;
  • Tiver experiência com arquitetura de projetos complexos.



O que oferecemos aos nossos Rethinkers?

Básico que a gente ama

  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Kit de onboarding com todas as ferramentas essenciais e mimos exclusivos para Rethinkers

Saúde e bem-estar

  • Auxílio bem-estar mensal
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico;
  • Saúde mental com a plataforma Conexa Saúde
  • Wellhub para cuidar do corpo em movimento
  • On Happy para planejar suas viagens à lazer



Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Software Engineer
description:
Ascendion is a full-service digital engineering solutions company. We make and manage software platforms and products that power growth and deliver captivating experiences to consumers and employees. Our engineering, cloud, data, experience design, and talent solution capabilities accelerate transformation and impact for enterprise clients. Headquartered in New Jersey, our workforce of 6,000+ Ascenders delivers solutions from around the globe. Ascendion is built differently to engineer the next.

Ascendion | Engineering to elevate life

We have a culture built on opportunity, inclusion, and a spirit of partnership. Come, change the world with us:

  • Build the coolest tech for world’s leading brands
  • Solve complex problems – and learn new skills
  • Experience the power of transforming digital engineering for Fortune 500 clients
  • Master your craft with leading training programs and hands-on experience

Experience a community of change makers!

Join a culture of high-performing innovators with endless ideas and a passion for tech. Our culture is the fabric of our company, and it is what makes us unique and diverse. The way we share ideas, learning, experiences, successes, and joy allows everyone to be their best at Ascendion.

About the Role:


  • Role: Software Engineer
  • Location: Brazil (Remote)
  • Employment Type: Contract


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain APIs using Apigee (preferred), KrakenD, or AWS API Gateway.
  • Implement scalable and secure API architectures using REST, gRPC, and GraphQL.
  • Develop backend services using Java (Spring Boot) and frontend applications using JavaScript/TypeScript with React or Angular.
  • Work with cloud environments such as AWS or GCP for deployment, scaling, and monitoring.
  • Utilize CI/CD pipelines (ADO Pipelines), GitHub, Docker, and Kubernetes to manage code, build processes, and deployments.
  • Write robust unit, integration, and automated tests using tools such as Cucumber and Mockito.
  • Contribute to cross-organization API standards, documentation, and best practices.
  • Collaborate with Agile/Scrum teams to deliver high-quality software solutions.


Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of overall professional experience.
  • Java (Spring Boot):
  • API Development:
  • API Management (Apigee/KrakenD/AWS Gateway): 3 years
  • Cloud Platforms (AWS/GCP):
  • JavaScript/TypeScript:
  • React/Angular:
  • Strong understanding of API protocols and architectural patterns (REST, gRPC, GraphQL).
  • Proficiency with CI/CD, GitHub, Docker, and Kubernetes.
  • Experience writing automated tests (Cucumber, Mockito).
  • Ability to write clear documentation and contribute to API governance efforts.

title: Senior Java Developer
description:
Decskill was founded in 2014 as an IT Consulting Company and their main mission is to delivery value through the knowledge. We enable companies to meet the chalenges of digital world by providing our clients with business models that ensure technological capacity, flexibility and agility. We are more than 500 consultants with offices in Lisbon, Porto and Madrid.


DECSKILL operates in 3 main areas:


• DECSKILL TALENT, through which we provide our clients with an extension to their IT teams;

• DECSKILL BOOST, through which we provide our client with software development models to increase capacity and optimize Time-to-Market, where we create and manage teams that deliver according to their needs, at the desired speed;

• DECSKILL CONNECT, through which we provide our client with consulting services, as well as the implementation and management of information technology infrastructures.


Our practice results in the creation of value for our customers, either by delivering qualified and value-added services, or through highly qualified and motivated professionals, as well as technology solutions that allow us to operate and transform the business of our customers.


We are looking for a Senior Java Developer for a remote project in Brazil.


Key requirements :


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in Java development and proficiency in the latest editions of Java, including expertise in Spring Boot.
  • Strong knowledge of AWS, Microservices architecture, and design patterns.
  • Strong knowledge of containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience in frontend technologies like React.js or Angular is a strong plus.
  • Experience in NodeJs and PostgreSQL database is a plus.
  • Solid grasp of security best practices related to APIs and data privacy.
  • Proficiency in Agile/Scrum methodologies and a commitment to driving Agile practices within the team.
  • Comfortable with DevOps practices involving configuration management, CI/CD pipelines, Gitflow, IaC, deployment patterns among others.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to addressing challenges.
  • Proficiency in English is a must.


Role and Key Accountabilities:


  • Translate application storyboards and use cases into functional applications.
  • Design, build and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code.
  • Ensure the best possible performance, quality and responsiveness of the applications.
  • Collaborate closely with the Product Owner to ensure alignment with business requirements and meet delivery timelines.
  • Prioritize and facilitate the early resolution of client issues, ensuring adherence to agreed Service Level Agreements (SLA).
  • Conduct code reviews, contribute to critical feature designs, and ensure the overall quality of the team's deliverables.
  • Flag technical debt and areas of improvements, making sure they are properly documented and taken into account when defining priorities.
  • Implement a robust documentation system for knowledge base, onboarding, knowledge transfer, and communication in software development activities.
  • Identify bottlenecks and bugs and devise solutions to these problems.
  • Follow Agile Scrum development process for application development.


If you’re interested in this job please send your CV in English to with reference “DA/SJD” .


Decskill is committed to equality and non-discrimination with all our talents. We recruit and promote talent, based on diversity and inclusion, regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, race, nationality or any other form of discrimination incompatible with the dignity of the human being.

title: Global Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as University of São Paulo, UNICAMP and UNESP. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are seeking a proactive, results-oriented Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our global HR team. In this role, you will drive the hiring of top-tier talent across Europe and APAC, and help us build high-performing teams in both technical and business functions. You will own the end-to-end recruitment process, build and nurture strong talent pipelines, and deliver a fast, high-quality hiring experience that directly contributes to our company’s growth and success worldwide.


Responsibilities:


  • Execute targeted hiring strategies to identify, and hire high-quality talent across sales, technical, and business roles.
  • Proactively source candidates using diverse channels, including job boards, social media, professional networks, referrals, and direct outreach.
  • Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline to support rapid hiring and future growth.
  • Partner closely with hiring managers to understand role requirements, skill needs, and success profiles.
  • Track and report key recruiting metrics (time-to-hire, pipeline quality, candidate conversion rates) to support continuous improvement.
  • Serve as a brand ambassador, ensuring candidates clearly understand the company’s mission, values, and employee experience.
  • Manage the full recruitment lifecycle—sourcing, screening, interviewing, coordinating assessments, and facilitating selection decisions.
  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date candidate data in the applicant tracking system (ATS).


Requirements :


  • A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in talent acquisition, preferably in software or technology companies.
  • Fluent English communication skills.
  • Experience supporting global recruitment, ideally across Europe and APAC.
  • Proficiency with recruiting and sourcing tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, and other platforms.
  • Ability to adapt quickly, work independently, and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Ambitious, results-driven, and thrives in high-growth settings.
  • Strong interpersonal, negotiation, and candidate experience skills.


Why Join JoVE?


  • You can expect compensation package competitively placed within the local market
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us
